headline: Trading Venues Flip To A 23.2 Million Dollar Outflow From A 53.3 Million Dollar Intake
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, flipped to a 23.2 million dollar net outflow, 0.0085 percent of custodied value, from a 53.3 million dollar net intake and 0.0195 percent on the prior print, which means dollars left the venues where holders can sell after they had been arriving. Bybit took in 91.7 million dollars, the largest intake on this print, while Binance took in 83.2 million dollars, down from 104.6 million dollars, which means fewer dollars arrived on the largest venue where holders can sell. Bitstamp sent out 85.5 million dollars, compared with 90.0 million dollars on the prior print, while Bitfinex took in 23.8 million dollars, down from 43.1 million dollars, which means fewer dollars arrived on that venue where holders can sell.
author: jordan
